messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a final, compact mapping for how we surface errors across API, SDKs, and console. Goal: unambiguous developer action + telemetry tags. Rolling this next week so want to lock examples.
kevin: What's the hard constraint? Back-compat with existing SDK consumers?
maria: Yes. Minimal breaking. Prefer additive fields. Also want console badges + sample copy for each bucket.
nash: Can we define explicit buckets first? e.g., RETRYABLE, DEGRADED, CLIENT_BAD_REQUEST, NONRECOVERABLE. That helps console + routing policies.
maria: Agreed. Proposal (4 buckets):
  - retryable: server transient (429 w/ Retry-After OR 503). SDKs should expose retry_hint and retry_after.
  - degraded: soft fallback (response returned but quality compromised). Return 200 but include warning header/body with code DEGRADED.
  - client_error: 4xx that caller should fix. Include parameter key if applicable.
  - fatal: server terminal (5xx unrecoverable) — no automatic retry.
kevin: For retryable we should include both header and body so old clients can still honor Retry-After header. Also add a machine-readable subcode.
maria: Exactly. Sample snippet: ```json
{"error": {"code": "RETRYABLE","subcode": "RATE_EXCEEDED","message": "tenant quota exhausted","retryable": true,"retry_after": 30,"trace_id": "rwd-xyz"}}
```
ash: Add telemetry tags: `signal.bucket`, `route_tier`, `fail_mode`. We'll use `signal.bucket=retryable` and `route_tier=dedicated|hosted`. Also include `sampling.reason` for degraded to reduce noise.
sofia: SDK concern: changing top-level `error` shape will break some clients that assume string messages. We should keep `message` and add `meta.redwood` for new details. e.g. `meta.redwood.retry_hint`. Backfill translations copy in console via keys.
alec: For console UX I suggest badges: 
  - Retry recommended (yellow) -> shows `retry_after` and link to docs
  - Degraded output (orange) -> shows affected routes + sample diff
  - Quota / Blocked (red) -> shows admin actions and contact info
We should wire thresholds: 1% of requests failing -> show banner; 5% -> page; use same telemetry buckets.
maria: Rollout plan: feature flag `error-surface-v2` gated by org, console opt-in, enable SDK parsing behind `X-RW-Errv=2`. Start canary for 48h with 5 tenants, expand to 25% traffic. We'll log full payloads to telemetry for 7 days, sample after.
devops-bot: Canary deploy for `error-surface-v2` scheduled: canary window 2026-03-30 02:00-06:00 UTC.
kevin: Also need i18n copy ownership. I'll take EN -> set up translation keys: `badge.retry.title`, `badge.degraded.title`, `badge.quota.title`.
maria: Great — I'll open an RFC PR with the mapping table, example payloads, header examples, and console mockups. Pinging @kevin @ash @sofia for review. :rocket:
sofia: lgtm — I'll try to review before EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
kevin: Will review after stand.
ash: One more ask — add an opt-out for teams that prefer legacy behavior (return 429 only).
maria: Good call. We'll add `X-RW-Compat: legacy` support for a transition period.
maria: Filing RFC PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/234 (draft)
